name: Call of Water
summary: Horde shamans journey south through the Barrens at Islen Waterseer's bidding, seeking Brine. There, they learn how water cleanses and heals.

sections.title: Lessons of the Tide
sections.body: Islen Waterseer teaches that water brings rebirth. It carves rock, washes away impurities, and mends flesh, but only when it is pure. Polluted water brings blight instead of life. Before seeking communion with water, every shaman must understand this balance.

sections.title: A Recluse in the Dust
sections.body: You travel far south through the arid Barrens to find Brine. Quilboar raids trouble the wastes, yet Brine lives alone, without guards or fear. She holds the knowledge and trials that will help you bind yourself to water.

faq.answer: Islen Waterseer is a shaman master on the Barrens coast, south of the Merchant Coast. She guides Horde shamans through trials of communion with water spirits.

faq.q: Why live in the southern Barrens surrounded by quilboar?
faq.answer: Brine lives alone in the southern wastes despite constant quilboar harassment. She knows outsiders may think it foolish, but keeps her reasons private and tests whether you have the fortitude to find her.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the water sapta?
faq.answer: A sapta is a ceremonial mixture that changes a shaman’s perception. It lets them see and speak with elemental spirits invisible to mortal eyes.

faq.q: What core lesson does water represent to a shaman?
faq.answer: Water brings rebirth, cleansing, and renewal. Pure water can heal, while tainted or stagnant water brings decay and devastation.

aliases: is call of water horde only
faq.answer: Horde shamans who have proved their dedication and attuned to earth and fire undertake the Call of Water trials.

faq.q: What threats lie on the path to Brine?
faq.answer: Aggressive quilboar tribes defend their thorned dens in the southern Barrens, and beasts hunt wanderers far from the safety of Crossroads or Camp Taurajo.

angles.text: As a shaman, communion with water marks a key step in your growth. It joins the strength of earth and force of fire with water’s healing power.
As a member of the Horde, you travel across Kalimdor to master the elements and honor the spirits that grant the Warchief’s shamans their vital magic.
